hero.lead: Professional treatments designed around your skin, your features and your pace. Results that look like you, only rested.
about.title: Professionalism first. Beauty, always.
about.p1: ByDee was founded on a simple belief: the best aesthetic work is the kind nobody notices. People simply see you, looking well.
about.p2: Every plan begins with an unhurried consultation and a skin assessment. We use only approved products and certified devices, and we will always tell you when less is more.
about.quote: “My job is to protect what makes your face yours.”
treat.title: Considered treatments, tailored to you.
treat.lead: Every treatment begins with a consultation, so your plan fits your skin, your goals and your schedule.
t1.title: Signature Facial
t1.text: Deep cleansing, gentle extraction and hydration tailored to your skin type.
t2.title: Skin Rejuvenation
t2.text: Microneedling and skin boosters to restore texture, glow and firmness.
t3.title: Laser Resurfacing
t3.text: Fractional laser to refine pores, soften scars and even out tone.
t5.title: Quadro Laser
t5.text: Quadro laser hair removal, comfortable and suited to most skin tones.
t6.title: Anti-Wrinkle
t6.text: Softens expression lines while keeping your face expressive.
results.title: Real change, gently made.
results.lead: Drag the handle, or focus it and use the arrow keys, to compare.
why.title: Trust, measured.
why.r1: Every treatment is performed by a registered nurse and certified aesthetic professional.
why.r2: Authentic, traceable products and certified devices.
why.r3: We recommend less when less is better, and say no when a treatment isn't right for you.
reviews.title: In their words.
booking.title: Your first visit starts with a conversation.
booking.lead: Send a request and we'll confirm by phone during opening hours. Prefer to chat? Message us on WhatsApp and we'll reply quickly.
